answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 10460 Country: India Title: is triple talaq valid if the lady has concieved within 3 months of iddah Question: is triple talaq valid if the lady has concieved within 3 months of iddah Answer ID: 10460 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 114/101=L/1429) The talaq is not affected by getting pregnant, the Talaq takes place during pregnancy as well, but her iddah will come to an end at delivery, as Allah said: واولات الاحمال اجلھن ان یضعن حملھن (ال آیۃ ) As for those having pregnancy, their term (of Iddah) is that they give birth to their child . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
